mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopping_cart (user_id, product_id, quantity, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE shopping_cart SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, p.name AS product_name, p.cover AS product_cover, p.price AS product_price, p.stock FROM shopping_cart c JOIN mall_product p ON p.id = c.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
